text: Appeal of Order to Comply for 997 The Queensway.

The Property Standards Committee, Etobicoke York Panel: 1. Amended the Order to Comply, dated May 30, 2018, regarding the property located at 997 The Queensway, to add Section 19.D(1)(a)(3) to Item Nos. 3 and 4. 2. Confirmed the Order to Comply, dated May 30, 2018, regarding the property located at 997 The Queensway, and in doing so granted an extension of time to October 15, 2018, with the proviso that the entire area be immediately made safe and continually maintained in a safe condition, to the satisfaction of Municipal Licensing and Standards, until the extended completion date of October 15, 2018.
